title: Nonlinearity as Rank: Generative Low-Rank Adapter with Radial Basis Functions
abstract: arXiv:2602.05709v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) approximates the update of a pretrained weight matrix using the product of two low-rank matrices. However, standard LoRA follows an explicit-rank paradigm, where increasing model capacity requires adding more rows or columns (i.e., basis vectors) to the low-rank matrices, leading to substantial parameter growth. In this paper, we find that these basis vectors exhibit significant parameter redundancy and can be compactly represented by lightweight nonlinear functions. Therefore, we propose Generative Low-Rank Adapter (GenLoRA), which replaces explicit basis vector storage with nonlinear basis vector generation. Specifically, GenLoRA maintains a latent vector for each low-rank matrix and employs a set of lightweight radial basis functions (RBFs) to synthesize the basis vectors. translated_title: 非线性即秩：基于径向基函数的生成式低秩适配器
translated_abstract: 低秩适配（LoRA）通过两个低秩矩阵的乘积来近似预训练权重矩阵的更新。然而，标准LoRA遵循显式秩范式，即增加模型容量需要向低秩矩阵中添加更多的行或列（即基向量），从而导致参数量大幅增长。在本文中，我们发现这些基向量存在显著的参数冗余，并且可以用轻量级的非线性函数进行紧凑表示。因此，我们提出了生成式低秩适配器（GenLoRA），用非线性基向量生成取代显式的基向量存储。具体而言，GenLoRA为每个低秩矩阵维护一个潜在向量，并利用一组轻量级的径向基函数（RBF）来合成基向量。每个径向基函数所需的参数远少于一个显式基向量，从而使GenLoRA具有更高的参数效率。广泛的实验……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现LoRA基向量存在显著参数冗余，提出GenLoRA用轻量级径向基函数从潜在向量生成基向量以替代显式存储，以更少的参数实现更高效率的低秩适配。
en_tdlr: GenLoRA exploits the parameter redundancy in LoRA's basis vectors by generating them from latent vectors via lightweight radial basis functions, replacing explicit storage and achieving higher parameter efficiency with far fewer parameters.
